job.title: Recruitment Consultant - Engineering
job.description:
Recruitment Consultant
Cardiff / Hybrid + flexible hours
£30,000 - £45,000 + uncapped commission + extensive benefits

Proud winners of Best Recruitment Company to Work For at the 2026 REC Awards!

Yolk Engineering & Technical is the largest division within Yolk Recruitment, working with manufacturing and engineering employers across the UK and Ireland. We recruit across established and emerging technical markets, partnering with businesses ranging from growing SMEs and scale-ups through to major international employers.

We're looking for experienced 360 Recruitment Consultants who want to develop a specialist market, build strong client relationships and increase both their earnings and their career opportunities.

There's a strong track record of Consultants achieving multiple promotions, salary increases and career-best commissions, and taking earnings to new levels. For those who want to progress into leadership, there's also a clear route into management and beyond.

You'll have the freedom to develop and take ownership of your own specialist market, with the backing of an established division, experienced colleagues and the resources to build something genuinely successful. You'll benefit from excellent recruitment technology, ongoing training and a business that rewards high performance properly.

What you'll be doing

  • Developing your own specialist market within engineering, manufacturing or technical recruitment
  • Winning new business and developing existing client relationships
  • Building a strong understanding of your clients, their businesses and their recruitment challenges
  • Advising clients on recruitment strategy, market conditions, salaries and candidate availability
  • Identifying, attracting and building genuine, long-term relationships with specialist candidates
  • Managing recruitment processes from initial brief through to interview, offer and placement
  • Negotiating salaries, rates and commercial terms
  • Developing lasting partnerships through a quality-led approach that puts relationships and reputation first
  • Working closely with the wider Engineering & Technical team to share knowledge, opportunities and relationships

What we're looking for

  • Successful experience in the recruitment industry
  • A genuine appetite for 360 recruitment and business development
  • The ambition to build and take ownership of your own market
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • Commercial awareness and confidence speaking with clients
  • Resilience and the ability to stay focused when things do not go to plan
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to work closely with the wider team
  • An interest in becoming genuinely knowledgeable within your recruitment specialism
  • Confidence using technology and new recruitment tools
  • Above all, we're looking for people with integrity, ambition and a desire to keep improving

What you'll get in return

  • £30,000 - £45,000 basic salary
  • Industry leading commission structure
  • Clear promotion and career development pathways, with a proven track record of rapid progression for high performers
  • Training and development tailored to your level of experience
  • Hybrid working
  • Flexible start times between 7.30am and 9am
  • Free on-site parking
  • Additional holidays, including your birthday, Christmas shutdown on top of your allowance, and a day to support a charity
  • £1,000 a year in discounts and savings towards everyday expenditure
  • Employee referral bonuses of up to £1,500
  • Regular social events, quarterly activities and an all-expenses-paid AGM afterparty
  • Private medical healthcare plan, including on-demand GP services and optical and dental cover
  • Access to professional financial advisors

If you're looking for a bigger opportunity to develop your market, earnings and career, apply here or contact our Engineering & Technical Managing Director for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Recruitment Consultant / Senior Recruitment Consultant

Technology Recruitment

Cardiff | £35,000 - £45,000 + Uncapped Commission

The Technology team at Yolk is growing, and we're looking for ambitious recruiters and proven sales professionals who want the opportunity to build something.

This isn't a role where you'll simply manage an established desk. It's an opportunity to build, develop and grow your own market within one of the most exciting and fastest-growing sectors in the UK economy.

We recruit across AI, Data, Software Engineering, Cloud, Infrastructure, Cyber Security and Technology Leadership, partnering with organisations ranging from high-growth scale-ups through to global consultancies and enterprise businesses.

You'll join an established technology practice with access to existing client relationships, proven delivery processes, marketing support, modern recruitment technology and experienced leadership, whilst having the freedom to build a market that genuinely feels like your own.

If you're ambitious, commercially driven and motivated by ownership, we'd like to speak with you.

Why Join Yolk?

We're ambitious, but we're not interested in KPI theatre. We trust good people to run their desks like professionals. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, build relationships and grow your market, whilst having the support of an established business behind you.

This is an opportunity to join a successful technology practice at a point of growth and play a genuine role in shaping its future.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

Build Your Own Market - You'll have the freedom to develop your own specialist area within technology recruitment, becoming a recognised expert in a market you can genuinely call your own.

Established Platform - You'll benefit from existing client relationships, warm introductions, marketing support, candidate networks and a recognised brand, giving you a strong foundation from day one.

High-Growth Sector - Technology remains one of the most in-demand recruitment markets in the UK and Europe. You'll recruit across cutting-edge areas including AI, Data, Software, Cloud and Cyber Security.

Real Progression - As you grow your market and your billing, clear progression opportunities are available into senior and leadership roles. Promotion targets/criteria are laid out simply for you with support and regular discussion on how to get to where you want.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Running a full 360 recruitment desk from business development through to placement
  • Developing and growing your own specialist market within technology
  • Building long-term relationships with candidates and hiring managers
  • Winning new business and growing existing client partnerships
  • Advising clients on market trends, salary benchmarking and hiring strategy
  • Managing recruitment processes from briefing through to offer and placement
  • Negotiating fees, salaries and contract rates
  • Becoming a recognised specialist within your chosen market
  • Contributing to the continued growth of the Technology team

What We're Looking For

We're interested in speaking with people from two backgrounds:

Experienced Recruiters

  • Previous recruitment experience in any sector
  • Strong relationship-building and business development skills
  • A track record of developing client relationships and generating revenue
  • Ambition to build and grow your own market

Sales & Business Development Professionals

  • Strong experience in sales, business development or account management
  • Evidence of achieving and exceeding targets
  • Confidence engaging senior decision-makers
  • Motivation to build a long-term career within recruitment

For both backgrounds, we're looking for people who are:

  • Commercially aware and driven by results
  • Comfortable having conversations that others avoid
  • Self-motivated and proactive
  • Relationship-focused
  • Ambitious and eager to build something of their own

Experience within technology recruitment isn't essential. Successful consultants in our team have joined from a variety of recruitment and sales backgrounds.

What You'll Get

  • Uncapped commission from day one
  • The opportunity to build and own your own market
  • Clear progression opportunities
  • Marketing, technology and leadership support
  • Hybrid working (3 days in office)
  • Flexible start times
  • Private medical healthcare
  • Birthday day off
  • Additional leave over the Christmas period
  • Quarterly incentives and team socials
  • Employee referral bonuses of up to £1,500

Ready to Build Something?

If you're an experienced recruiter looking for greater autonomy, or a proven sales professional looking to build a successful career in recruitment, this is an opportunity to develop your own market within one of the most exciting sectors in the industry.

For a confidential discussion, contact Lewis Allen or apply with your CV.

job.title: Principal Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Meritus are recruiting for a Senior / Principal Recruitment Consultant to join our expanding team and take a leading role in the growth of our UK Defence & National Security offering.

We’re looking for an experienced recruiter with a proven track record across Defence Technology, who wants the opportunity to build, develop and take ownership of a growing area of the Meritus business.

SENIOR / PRINCIPAL RECRUITMENT CONSULTANT - 360 RECRUITMENT - DEFENCE & NATIONAL SECURITY - £40,000 / £45,000 + COMMISSION - HYBRID / REMOTE - UK

Defence | National Security | Technology | Engineering

At Meritus, our mission is simple yet ambitious: to be the leading global supplier of elite professionals across the Aerospace, Defence, and Space industries.

We partner with some of the UK's leading Defence, Technology and Engineering organisations, supporting critical programmes across the UK and internationally.

We’re now looking for an experienced recruiter to help us grow our UK Defence & National Security business.

Why Join Meritus?

Build Something Significant

This isn't about inheriting a desk and managing an established market.

We already have multiple Defence & National Security accounts, strong client relationships and significant opportunities for growth.

We’re looking for someone with a founding mentality who wants to take those foundations and build something significant.

Ownership & Autonomy

You’ll have genuine ownership of your market, with the freedom to develop existing accounts, win new business and shape our Defence recruitment offering.

Your success will be measured not only by individual performance, but by the growth and development of the market you build.

Established Platform, Entrepreneurial Mindset

You’ll have the support, infrastructure and existing relationships of an established recruitment business, combined with the opportunity to operate with the autonomy and commercial mindset of building your own business.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and grow key Defence & National Security accounts.

  • Build and develop long-term relationships with senior stakeholders across the Defence Technology ecosystem.

  • Identify and win new business opportunities.

  • Deliver high-quality recruitment across specialist Defence, Engineering and Technology markets.

  • Build a strong candidate network across the UK Defence sector.

  • Take ownership of your market and develop a clear strategy for growth.

  • Work closely with the wider Meritus team to expand our Defence offering.

  • Represent Meritus with clients, candidates and industry stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the continued growth and development of the wider business.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced Senior or Principal Recruitment Consultant with a strong track record within Defence / National Security recruitment.

You’ll ideally have:

  • A proven track record of strong delivery and personal billings.

  • Existing relationships within the UK Defence Technology market.

  • Experience recruiting across technical, engineering or specialist Defence environments.

  • A strong track record of account development and business development.

  • The commercial drive to grow existing relationships and win new clients.

  • An entrepreneurial or founding mentality.

  • The ambition to take ownership and help build something bigger than an individual desk.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with the business and play a genuine role in shaping the future of Meritus' Defence offering.

What We Offer

Culture of Excellence & Reward

  • Industry-leading commission structure and competitive base salary.

  • Company and team high-achiever trips.

  • Monthly and quarterly team-building events.

  • Clear, self-directed progression pathways.

  • Tailored training and development.

  • Genuine opportunity to progress into leadership as the business grows.

Annual Rewards & Benefits

  • Annual company AGM with fully expensed afterparty.

  • Fully expensed Christmas party and additional paid leave over Christmas.

  • Up to £1,500 employee referral bonus.

  • £1,000 per year in discounts and savings toward everyday expenditure.

Wellbeing Focused

  • Access to a qualified professional health & wellbeing service.

  • Boosted annual leave, including all bank holidays.

  • Your birthday off — on us.

  • Flexible hybrid and remote working options.

Ready to Build Something?

If you're an experienced Defence recruiter who has a strong track record of delivery and billings, but you're now looking for more ownership, autonomy and the opportunity to build a significant part of a growing business, we'd like to hear from you.

Join Meritus and help us build the next phase of our UK Defence & National Security offering.
